description: Experimental extraction-only build of Pake Desktop for testing the embedded application payload.
notes: Experimental extraction-only package. It bypasses the Velopack setup process, so the generated root launcher, Update.exe, and sq.version are not installed. Use Scoop to update this test package; Velopack in-app self-updating is not supported by this extraction layout. Pake-created apps and user data remain outside the Scoop app directory under %LOCALAPPDATA%.
